name: intercom-church
description: Church Production Comms: voice intercom for the video director and camera operators on the church LAN.

scripts.build: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.test: npm run build:protocol && npm run test:launcher && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @church-comms/server" "npm run dev --workspace @church-comms/web"
